mapper.select:
SELECT C.CAMP_ID AS contentId, C.CAMP_NAME AS facltNm, C.ADDRESS AS addr1, C.LATITUDE AS mapY, C.LONGITUDE AS mapX, C.DESCRIPTION AS lineIntro, I.IMG_URL AS firstImageUrl FROM CAMP C LEFT JOIN CAMP_IMG I ON C.CAMP_ID = I.CAMP_ID AND I.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE 1=1
AND C.ADDRESS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{selectedArea}, '%')
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO CAMP (CAMP_ID, CAMP_NAME, ADDRESS, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, DESCRIPTION) VALUES
(#{item.contentId}, #{item.facltNm}, #{item.addr1}, #{item.mapY}, #{item.mapX}, #{item.lineIntro})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ADDRESS = VALUES(ADDRESS), DESCRIPTION = VALUES(DESCRIPTION)
INSERT INTO CAMP_IMG (CAMP_ID, IMG_URL, IS_MAIN) VALUES (#{campId}, #{imgUrl}, 'Y') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE IMG_URL = VALUES(IMG_URL)
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, CONTENT AS content, RATING AS rating, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt FROM CAMP_REVIEW WHERE CAMP_ID = #{campId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
